summary: Gives generic rules for forwarding 6LoWPAN fragments across a multi-hop route-over network. Forwarding fragments can improve end-to-end latency and reliability and reduce buffer needs on intermediate nodes. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: When a big message is cut into pieces, a node in the middle can pass each piece along right away instead of waiting to collect all of them. This document gives rules for doing that.
